title: 281. Unique Binary Search Trees

examples.explanation: Five distinct BST shapes exist over three ordered values.
A single node forms exactly one tree.

hints: Let dp[i] be the count for i nodes; dp[0] = dp[1] = 1.
For i >= 2, dp[i] = sum over roots r of dp[r-1] * dp[i-r].
Fill dp bottom-up from 2 to n.
